about.heading: About Eya
about.lead: Hi, I’m Eya: Marketing Manager, Business Developer, content strategist, and partnership closer. I move between a regulated healthcare platform one week and a motorsport brand built from zero the next.
about.body: Over the last four years I’ve grown a brand community by 165%, built social and content systems from scratch, and sourced and closed influencer and agency partnerships. The full business-development cycle, not just the marketing half of it. I work well with ambiguity, bridge technical and business teams, and report results in numbers, not adjectives.

points.title: Challenge
points.body: Grow qualified demand and audience while keeping content, SEO, and an AI-powered diagnostic feature moving in step with developers and medical specialists.

points.title: Approach
points.body: Owned go-to-market strategy end-to-end; sourced, negotiated, and closed influencer and agency partnerships; ran the content calendar across Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn; kept website SEO and UX on track.

points.title: Results
points.body: Community grew from 20K to 53K followers (+165%). AI-powered skin-diagnosis feature shipped through sustained cross-functional collaboration.

points.title: Data & enablement
points.body: Turned Google Analytics and Meta Insights data into reporting that shapes strategy, and built the pitch decks and business cases behind sales conversations and partner negotiations.

points.title: From zero
points.body: The brand had no structured content, storytelling, or campaigns. I defined content pillars and owned the full editorial calendar.

points.title: Creative system
points.body: Directed briefs, scripts, and visual direction; partnered with creators on reels, stories, and posts, building the social strategy from the ground up.

points.title: Results
points.body: A cohesive, premium feed aesthetic across platforms and significant engagement growth in saves, shares, and comments.

points.title: Go-to-market
points.body: Owned go-to-market and content strategy for a digital mental-healthcare platform, translating complex clinical concepts into accessible communication for patients and providers.

points.title: Partner acquisition
points.body: Researched and approached clinics and healthcare providers, developing pitch decks and business cases supported by market and competitor analysis.

points.title: Trust in a regulated category
points.body: Ran Tachafy’s Instagram and LinkedIn end to end (planning, creative concepts, and publishing), building brand trust in a sensitive healthcare space.
